title: New Event Spawner Plugin for RPG Maker MZ from CocoMode (Free!)

posts.author: CocoMode
posts.body:
Hi,
Check out my new,  useful (and free!) plugin for RPG maker MZ: an
Event Spawner
that enables game developers to dynamically spawn, despawn and transform events in the game (either single or multiple events) based on various conditions and parameters, accommodating diverse game scenarios that are not possible otherwise.
Also, In addition to the features usually implemented in an event spawner, this plugin allows the creation of skills, spells, items etc. that allow the PLAYER to perform event spawning, despawning and transforming as part of game scenarios. For example:
A spell scroll that turns an ugly frog into a beautiful princess:
An animal "giving birth" to offsprings:
The Player conjuring up a demon:
Or harvesting crops:
These are just a few cursory examples - many more scenarios are made possible with the plugin!
Other than on itch.io, you can also find the plugin on
Gumroad
.
Any constructive criticism is welcome and appreciated. If you find any bugs or problems with the plugin please report them in the comments section and I will do my best to fix them.
enjoy!
CocoMode
